basic_profile.bio: I'm a game developer and tech enthusiast living in Seattle. I've been creating indie games using Godot for over five years now and love sharing tips with the community. Besides game development, I'm a huge fan of eSports, especially FPS games like Battlefield. I also enjoy playing tennis and have been trying to improve my skills in the sport. In my downtime, I listen to podcasts, particularly 'Dear Hank and John'. I work as a software engineer during the day and spend evenings gaming or contributing to online forums. I'm married to my college sweetheart, and we have a mischievous tabby cat named Pixel. I'm usually active on Reddit during late evenings or weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been actively involved in game development communities since college. My expertise lies in coding game mechanics and optimizing game performance, primarily using Godot and Unity. I've taught myself a lot through online resources and forums and enjoy helping newcomers to the field.
